name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast by default for all interactive elements. This ensures keyboard users can see focus clearly even on low-contrast backgrounds, meeting WCAG AAA for focus visibility. The trade-off is slightly larger touch targets, but that benefits mobile users too—no downside.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 4px at 7:1 fails users toggling *both* reduced motion *and* high contrast—WCAG warns reduced motion overrides contrast requirements. Better: 3px at 4.5:1 meets focus visibility without breaking when users combine settings. Settle it: test with screen readers toggling both modes; if it fails, adopt 3px at 4.5:1.
